caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular sampler design on a light beige or off-white background, composed primarily of embroidered letters, numbers, and floral patterns in colored thread. Along the outer edge, there is a decorative border featuring green leafy stems with red flowers. Inside this border, at the top section, uppercase letters in blue are arranged in two rows, followed by uppercase letters and numbers in red, then lowercase letters in green. Beneath the letters, a horizontal vine with red and pink flowers runs across the width. Below the vine, centrally, is a circular floral arrangement with the text "Mary S Smith Wrought this Sampler 1851 Carlisle" stitched in blue. Flanking this central text are two mirrored arrangements of red and pink flowers with green leaves. Below this, three smaller floral motifs are distributed horizontally, with the central motif being a larger, ornate bouquet in a curved vase, predominantly red, pink, green, and violet, labeled “School No 8” underneath in blue. On either side of the central bouquet are two smaller pots, each containing yellow-flowered plants. The overall composition is symmetrical and colorful, using blue, red, green, yellow, pink, and violet threads for the embroidery.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
